reviewed_actual_frames.interpretation: Actual computer Desktop is clearly rendered at 1920x1080. Photo Lab, Ship Status, Mission Log, Upgrade, Journal, Rest, Cargo and Exit icons and taskbar are legible. This is a real frame check, not proof of subjective atmosphere.

Actual Photo Lab shows photo2/2 graded GoodPhoto, mission data detected, creature filling much of the dark-blue specimen image and a readable SEND control. A distinct distant wreck cannot be confidently identified from this single frame; source compositor support alone is not visible-recognition proof.

Actual Mission Log contains the dark recovered-coordinate fragment card. Both signal coordinate lines, the radar-verification instruction, completed progress bar and Mission Log window controls are readable. Actual JPEG corroborates the fragmentVisual flag; it does not establish human reading speed or fear.
